durable_index_proposal.admission: New sticky reader fence/version before first indexed intent; old/unindexed feature history cannot be assumed empty without bounded legacy reconciliation or explicit refusal.
durable_index_proposal.shape: Bounded per-attempt/per-step keys in native protected namespace; avoid read-modify-write singleton map lost-update races. Values bind original open/incarnation, database birth, range, attempt, proposal/history/intent/step hashes, logical TxID/mutation hash and actual page intent XID. It is restrictive debt, never grant.
durable_index_proposal.publish: Insert exact outstanding entry in SAME actual native page transaction/XID as RowIntent, before any logical commit WAL; readback checks both exact values and committed page outcome.
durable_index_proposal.clear: Delete corresponding entry in SAME actual native page transaction/XID as exact RowsHeader protected progress; header is durable restrictive surrogate. Caller postchecks still gate live completion and leases, never reconstructed from cleared entry.
durable_index_proposal.bounds: Hard count/per-entry/total-byte admission bounds, cursor scan max+1 rejects overflow. Malformed, mismatched, unknown feature state, scan error or incomplete scan fails closed, never empty.
durable_index_proposal.guard: Acquire actual RAM pin before insertion (existing fix); common cut holds native cut guard while checking committed index and doing physical rewrite. Keep explicit gate/pin/index lock order to prevent empty-scan/insert/cut race; startup holds exclusive directory ownership.
durable_index_proposal.initial_behavior: Normal open refuses if outstanding entry exists before generic replay. Common cut refuses/defers if any debt. This is evidence preservation/admission only, not cold resume or HA.

self_healing_limit: A plain open error safely preserves debt but cannot finish relocation or self-heal. A separate CLOSED cold-repair handle must keep exclusive directory ownership, permit only the bounded exact pending-intent resolver/materialization protocol, retain original attempt/Tx/history obligations, and reacquire actual current native/metadata authority before any image publication or Serving. It may not silently fall back to ordinary generic open or create a replacement transaction.
cold_child_test_precision: Use a real subprocess and actual SIGKILL after an fsynced external seam marker proving logical outcome AppliedKnown or WalDurablePendingApply but before protected RowsHeader commit. Parent waits for child termination and directory lock release before opening; never graceful Drop/close (that changes cut behavior), never reopen a live store. Preserve before/after logical WAL, native intent/index/hash/page outcomes, actual stderr/error and business log/outbox IDs. This is a physical-process cold component, not independent-machine power loss or HA qualification.
